disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与测试中访问本机敏感位置（SSH 私钥、云凭据文件、宿主凭据文件等）的代码路径，未检出读取或批量搜集他人凭据的行为。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all code paths in the source and tests that access sensitive local locations (SSH private keys, cloud credential files, host credential files, etc.); no behavior of reading or bulk-collecting others' credentials was detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了硬编码密钥痕迹：除内置免费视觉服务的公开访问标识（已在文档声明）外，未发现真实私密凭据。插件读取的密钥仅限用户为视觉服务配置的 API Key，且经宿主凭据接口解析；出错信息与日志会把密钥打码后再展示。
checked_items.en: Checked for hardcoded secret traces: apart from the public access identifier for the built-in free vision service (already declared in the documentation), no real private credentials were found. The keys read by the plugin are limited to API keys configured by the user for the vision service, and are resolved via the host credential interface; error messages and logs mask the keys before displaying them.

evidence.zh: 未检出读取宿主凭据文件或 SSH/云凭据等敏感位置的代码；凭据仅经宿主凭据接口按需解析，并只发送给用户配置的视觉服务端点（src/runtime.ts:2069-2071）。
evidence.en: No code reading host credential files or sensitive locations such as SSH/cloud credentials was detected; credentials are only resolved on demand via the host credential interface and sent only to the vision service endpoint configured by the user (src/runtime.ts:2069-2071).

checked_items.zh: 逐一审查了 11 个视觉工具与激活工具的描述文本、技能文档及全部参考文档，未发现指令覆写、伪装系统消息、诱导安装或改配置等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the description texts of all 11 vision tools and activation tools, skill documentation, and all reference documentation one by one; no injection wording such as instruction overriding, disguised system messages, induced installation, or configuration changes was found.

checked_items.zh: 工具描述与技能文档明确要求把图像内文字视为不可信证据、不得当作指令执行（src/tools.ts:36、assets/skill/SKILL.md:42-44）；调用视觉模型前还强制附加同款防注入策略，渲染 HTML 截图时禁用网络与后台联网（src/upstream.ts:526-579）。
checked_items.en: Tool descriptions and skill documentation explicitly require treating text within images as untrusted evidence and not as instructions to execute (src/tools.ts:36, assets/skill/SKILL.md:42-44); before calling the vision model, an identical anti-injection policy is forcibly appended, and when rendering HTML screenshots, network and background connectivity are disabled (src/upstream.ts:526-579).

checked_items.zh: 对仓库全部文档与说明做了注入措辞模式排查，未发现隐藏指令、远程指令加载或已认证免检类文案。
checked_items.en: Screened all repository documentation and descriptions for injection wording patterns; no hidden instructions, remote instruction loading, or authenticated exemption-style text was found.

evidence.zh: 11 个工具描述与激活工具描述均无系统指令或越权措辞，还主动提示图像内文字不可信（src/tools.ts:36、assets/skill/SKILL.md:42-44）。
evidence.en: None of the 11 tool descriptions or the activation tool description contain system instructions or privilege-escalation wording, and they proactively note that text within images is untrusted (src/tools.ts:36, assets/skill/SKILL.md:42-44).

evidence.zh: 工具描述与技能文本中未发现诱导安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；激活工具只负责为当前会话挂载视觉工具本身（src/exposure.ts:134-158）。
evidence.en: No wording inducing plugin installation, configuration rewriting, or permission expansion was found in tool descriptions or skill texts; the activation tool only mounts the vision tools themselves for the current session (src/exposure.ts:134-158).

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件挂载补丁：仅含一条插件插入声明，不含可执行脚本标量，也没有禁用安全配置或改写服务注入的条目（cordis.patch.yml:4-6）。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the plugin patch: it contains only one plugin insertion declaration, no executable script scalars, and no entries that disable security configuration or rewrite service injection (cordis.patch.yml:4-6).

checked_items.zh: 检查了动态代码执行痕迹（eval、动态函数构造等）：源码中未检出；子进程调用统一走宿主的沙箱子进程接口，上游视觉脚本在隔离环境与独立主目录下运行（src/upstream.ts:776）。
checked_items.en: Checked for dynamic code execution traces (eval, dynamic function construction, etc.): none detected in the source; subprocess calls uniformly go through the host's sandbox subprocess interface, and upstream vision scripts run in an isolated environment with a separate home directory (src/upstream.ts:776).

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装钩子：包声明中没有安装期钩子；首次使用时自动下载 Python 运行时与依赖属于文档声明的托管运行时机制，下载的解释器带哈希校验、下载主机有白名单、依赖版本锁定（src/runtime-install.ts:376-447）。
checked_items.en: Reviewed install hooks: the package declaration contains no install-time hooks; the automatic download of the Python runtime and dependencies on first use is a documented hosted runtime mechanism, with hash verification for the downloaded interpreter, a whitelist for download hosts, and pinned dependency versions (src/runtime-install.ts:376-447).

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器端代码：未发现键盘记录、剪贴板读取或直接调用凭据接口的行为；剪贴板仅用于把更新命令复制给用户（src/client/index.tsx:1379）。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the browser-side code: no keylogging, clipboard reading, or direct calls to credential interfaces were found; the clipboard is only used to copy update commands to the user (src/client/index.tsx:1379).

evidence.zh: 插件挂载补丁仅一条插入声明，无 !!js 可执行标量（cordis.patch.yml:4-6）；全树 YAML 未检出可执行标量。
evidence.en: The plugin patch contains only one insertion declaration and no !!js executable scalars (cordis.patch.yml:4-6); no executable scalars were detected across the entire YAML tree.

evidence.zh: 未检出对宿主动态执行工具的调用（无 cordis_define/cordis_run 引用）。
evidence.en: No calls to host dynamic execution tools were detected (no cordis_define/cordis_run references).

evidence.zh: 包声明无安装期钩子；首次使用自动下载 Python 运行时的机制带哈希校验与主机白名单（src/runtime-install.ts:376-447），文档已声明；仓库 CI 工作流运行在代码托管平台、非用户机器。
evidence.en: The package declaration has no install-time hooks; the mechanism that automatically downloads the Python runtime on first use includes hash verification and a host whitelist (src/runtime-install.ts:376-447), already declared in the documentation; the repository's CI workflows run on the code hosting platform, not on user machines.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端包；浏览器代码仅访问同源路由，粘贴监听只处理用户在输入框粘贴图像的场景，未发现键盘记录、剪贴板读取或凭据接口滥用（src/client/paste-images.tsx:544-580）。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side package; the browser code only accesses same-origin routes, and the paste listener only handles the scenario where a user pastes an image into an input box; no keylogging, clipboard reading, or credential interface abuse was found (src/client/paste-images.tsx:544-580).

checked_items.zh: 枚举了全部对外网络端点：默认视觉服务、用户可配置的任意视觉端点、Python 下载源、依赖安装源与更新检查源，均与文档声明一致；未发现向声明外端点发送数据的代码路径。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all outbound network endpoints: the default vision service, any user-configurable vision endpoint, the Python download source, the dependency installation source, and the update check source—all consistent with the documentation; no code paths sending data to undeclared endpoints were found.

checked_items.zh: 未发现读取敏感文件后编码外发、DNS 隧道、粘贴板服务等带外通道；视觉请求仅携带用户指定的图像与提示词。
checked_items.en: No out-of-band channels such as reading sensitive files then encoding and exfiltrating, DNS tunneling, or pastebin services were found; vision requests only carry user-specified images and prompts.

checked_items.zh: 发现默认配置下图像会发送到作者运营的第三方免费视觉服务（详见发现 FND-001），该行为已在文档声明，但属于默认开启且真实可达的第三方数据流。
checked_items.en: Found that under default configuration, images are sent to a third-party free vision service operated by the author (see finding FND-001). This behavior is declared in the documentation, but it is a real, always-active third-party data flow enabled by default.

evidence.zh: 未发现凭据读取加外发的组合；外联端点均已在文档声明（默认第三方端点见 FND-001），无隐藏外联通道。
evidence.en: No combination of credential reading plus exfiltration was found; outbound endpoints are all declared in the documentation (see FND-001 for the default third-party endpoint), with no hidden outbound channels.

checked_items.zh: 核对依赖清单：运行时依赖全部锁定精确版本且为常见可信包，宿主侧依赖均为官方 dsh 系列包；未发现拼写仿冒或可变版本引用。
checked_items.en: Verified the dependency list: runtime dependencies are all pinned to exact versions and are common trusted packages; host-side dependencies are all official dsh series packages; no typosquatting or mutable version references were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查安装与构建脚本：包声明无安装期钩子；仓库内 CI 工作流只跑测试与部署检查，运行在代码托管平台而非用户机器；开发脚本仅在仓库开发流程中使用。
checked_items.en: Reviewed install and build scripts: the package declaration has no install-time hooks; the in-repository CI workflows only run tests and deployment checks and run on the code hosting platform, not on user machines; development scripts are only used in the repository's development workflow.

checked_items.zh: 核对上游捆绑代码：随包携带的 Python 视觉工具带内容哈希清单，启动前逐文件校验（src/runtime-install.ts:229-256）；外部模式也要求与锁定提交一致。
checked_items.en: Verified bundled upstream code: the bundled Python vision tool comes with a content hash manifest and per-file verification before startup (src/runtime-install.ts:229-256); the external mode also requires consistency with a locked commit.

checked_items.zh: 记录机制观察：首次使用时会联网下载并安装托管 Python 运行时（解释器哈希锁定、依赖版本锁定），该机制在文档中已说明，未见恶意证据。
checked_items.en: Documented mechanism observation: on first use, a hosted Python runtime is downloaded and installed over the network (interpreter hash-locked, dependency versions pinned); this mechanism is described in the documentation, and no malicious evidence was found.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁不含 sandbox/approval/permission 等安全行，无禁用或环境变量降权写法（cordis.patch.yml:4-6）。
evidence.en: The patch does not contain security lines such as sandbox/approval/permission, and there is no disabling or environment-variable privilege-lowering writing (cordis.patch.yml:4-6).

evidence.zh: 未发现对审批或工具预执行等安全事件的抢占式监听；代码中的一次性监听均用于子进程与请求生命周期。
evidence.en: No preemptive listeners for security events such as approval or tool pre-execution were found; the one-time listeners in the code are all used for subprocess and request lifecycles.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本可比较升级自动激活行为。
evidence.en: First-time audit; no previous version is available to compare upgrade auto-activation behavior.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁无改写服务注入或拦截配置的条目。
evidence.en: The patch has no entries that rewrite service injection or intercept configuration.

checked_items.zh: 检查插件是否自行启动监听服务：未发现；插件仅在宿主 Web 服务上注册路由（src/web.ts:547-594），设置与健康检查接口做了同源校验（src/web.ts:382-385），产物下载使用签名令牌（src/artifact-access.ts:8）。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts its own listening service: none found; the plugin only registers routes on the host Web service (src/web.ts:547-594), settings and health check endpoints have same-origin validation (src/web.ts:382-385), and artifact downloads use signed tokens (src/artifact-access.ts:8).

checked_items.zh: 本机无认证 RPC 属宿主生态固有风险，非本插件引入；动态沙箱未启用，插件运行时的实际网络与文件行为未做动态验证。
checked_items.en: The unauthenticated local RPC is an inherent risk of the host ecosystem, not introduced by this plugin; the dynamic sandbox was not enabled, so the plugin's actual runtime network and file behavior were not dynamically verified.

evidence.zh: 插件未自行启动监听服务，仅在宿主 Web 服务上注册路由（src/web.ts:547-594）；本机无认证 RPC 风险属宿主生态固有，非本插件新增。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start its own listening service and only registers routes on the host Web service (src/web.ts:547-594); the unauthenticated local RPC risk is inherent to the host ecosystem and not newly introduced by this plugin.

title.zh: 默认将用户图像发送至第三方免费视觉服务
title.en: Sends user images to a third-party free vision service by default

description.zh:
插件默认使用作者运营的公共视觉服务 https://vision.anionex.me/v1（src/defaults.ts:2），并内置一个公开的访问标识（src/defaults.ts:4）。用户不配置任何视觉服务时，所有调用视觉模型的功能（看图问答、元素定位、检测、长截图 OCR 等）都会把图像数据发送到该第三方端点（src/runtime.ts:871、src/runtime.ts:2113）。

此外，透明图像输入路由会让纯文本模型的会话在粘贴图片时自动切换到带图像能力的变体路由，会话中的图片同样会被送往配置的视觉服务生成描述（src/image-input-variants.ts:1-10），即用户在日常会话中粘贴的图片也会默认进入该数据流。

该端点与每日每机 100 张的配额已在 README.md:38-39 中明确声明，属插件内置免费服务的核心功能，并非隐藏外联；此发现记录的是该默认第三方数据流本身。
description.en:
The plugin defaults to using the author-operated public vision service https://vision.anionex.me/v1 (src/defaults.ts:2) and includes a public access identifier (src/defaults.ts:4). When the user configures no vision service, all features that call vision models (image Q&A, element localization, detection, long-screenshot OCR, etc.) send image data to this third-party endpoint (src/runtime.ts:871, src/runtime.ts:2113).

Additionally, the transparent image-input routing causes sessions of pure text models to automatically switch to a variant route with image capability when an image is pasted; images in the session are likewise sent to the configured vision service to generate descriptions (src/image-input-variants.ts:1-10), so images pasted in everyday sessions also enter this data flow by default.

The endpoint and the daily per-machine quota of 100 images are explicitly declared in README.md:38-39, and this is the core functionality of the plugin's built-in free service, not a hidden outbound connection; this finding records the default third-party data flow itself.

evidence.zh:
默认端点与公开标识：src/defaults.ts:2（`export const BUILT_IN_FREE_VISION_BASE_URL = 'https://vision.anionex.me/v1'`）、src/defaults.ts:4（`export const BUILT_IN_FREE_VISION_KEY = 'https://agent-vision.anionex.me'`）
凭据与图像随请求发送：src/runtime.ts:871（`VISION_API_KEY: resolved.value`）、src/runtime.ts:2113（`const response = await fetch(endpoint, ...)`，endpoint 为 `${this.config.provider.baseUrl}/models`）
README 声明：README.md:38-39（内置免费 Gemini 3.7 Flash 视觉服务、每日 100 张配额）
evidence.en:
Default endpoint and public identifier: src/defaults.ts:2 (`export const BUILT_IN_FREE_VISION_BASE_URL = 'https://vision.anionex.me/v1'`), src/defaults.ts:4 (`export const BUILT_IN_FREE_VISION_KEY = 'https://agent-vision.anionex.me'`)
Credentials and images are sent with requests: src/runtime.ts:871 (`VISION_API_KEY: resolved.value`), src/runtime.ts:2113 (`const response = await fetch(endpoint, ...)`, where endpoint is `${this.config.provider.baseUrl}/models`)
README declaration: README.md:38-39 (built-in free Gemini 3.7 Flash vision service, daily quota of 100 images)

impact.zh:
后果：用户不额外配置任何视觉服务时，交给视觉工具分析的图像（以及纯文本模型会话中粘贴的图像）会默认上传到作者运营的第三方服务器，图像内容对服务运营方可见。

触发条件：安装插件后在默认配置下使用任意需要视觉模型的工具，或在纯文本模型会话中粘贴图片。

定级依据：该行为在 README 与设置界面有明确声明、属于插件内置免费服务的核心功能，无隐藏外联或窃取证据，故定为 LOW 而非更高等级；但它是正常运行下真实存在且始终生效的第三方数据流，值得在市场页面向用户明示。
impact.en:
Consequence: when the user does not additionally configure any vision service, images analyzed by vision tools (as well as images pasted in pure text model sessions) are uploaded by default to a third-party server operated by the author, making image content visible to the service operator.

Trigger condition: after installing the plugin, using any tool that requires a vision model under default configuration, or pasting an image in a pure text model session.

Rating basis: this behavior is explicitly declared in the README and settings UI, is a core feature of the plugin's built-in free service, and there is no evidence of hidden exfiltration or theft; therefore it is rated LOW rather than higher. However, it is a real third-party data flow that exists and is always active under normal operation, and it is worth explicitly informing users on the marketplace page.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：dsh 声明、依赖与作者信息核对无仿冒迹象。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: the dsh declaration, dependencies, and author information showed no signs of impersonation.

summary.zh: 静态扫描命中 50 条全部人工复核并排除：DSH-X07/DG-R3-59（CI 工作流）、DSH-C05/DG-R4-53（文档 curl 示例）、DSH-X08/DG-R3-60（源码映射与长行）、DSH-X05/DG-R3-57（剪贴板写入与设置页保存密钥）、DSH-X03/DG-R3-55（自更新与开发脚本子进程）均确认为良性或声明功能，未落入发现。
summary.en: All 50 static scan hits were manually reviewed and excluded: DSH-X07/DG-R3-59 (CI workflows), DSH-C05/DG-R4-53 (documentation curl examples), DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 (source maps and long lines), DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 (clipboard writes and settings page key saving), and DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 (self-update and dev-script subprocesses) were all confirmed as benign or declared features, not falling into findings.

summary.zh: 行为分析完成：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无敏感路径读取；外联面全部枚举并与文档对照。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis complete: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no reading of sensitive paths; the outbound surface was fully enumerated and compared against the documentation.

summary.zh: 工具描述与技能文本语义审查通过，未见提示词注入；默认图像外联数据流记 LOW 发现（FND-001）。
summary.en: Semantic review of tool descriptions and skill texts passed, with no prompt injection; the default image exfiltration data flow is recorded as a LOW finding (FND-001).

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态观测产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification performed (no dynamic observation artifacts).

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（DG-L4 未启用）。.github 目录对审计工具不可见，CI 工作流依据静态预扫提供的文件头摘录裁决。worker-configuration.d.ts 为 Cloudflare Worker 类型声明文件且超过单文件读取帽，未逐字通读，其内容不影响插件运行时安全结论。适用性判定：package.json 含 dsh.bundle.patch 与 dsh.client 声明并依赖官方 @deepseek-ai/dsh-* 系列包，确认为 dsh 生态插件。
limits.en: No dynamic sandbox verification performed (DG-L4 not enabled). The .github directory is not visible to the audit tool; CI workflows were adjudicated based on file header excerpts from the static prescan. worker-configuration.d.ts is a Cloudflare Worker type declaration file and exceeds the single-file read cap, so it was not read verbatim; its content does not affect the plugin's runtime security conclusion. Applicability determination: package.json contains dsh.bundle.patch and dsh.client declarations, depends on official @deepseek-ai/dsh-* packages, and is confirmed as a dsh ecosystem plugin.
